listAgents.what: Show your agents: your devices and who works for you.

viewAgent.what: Show one agent: what it can do and may do.

setAgentSkillExposure.what: Show or hide one of an agent's skills from others.

getAgentSkillExposure.what: Show which of an agent's skills others can see.

createProfile.what: Make a new persona, recoverable with your recovery phrase.

params.name: the name
params.properties: what it takes over from you

setProfileProperty.what: Record something about a persona, such as where you live.

getProfileProperties.what: Show what is recorded about a persona.

setProfileDriver.what: Record what drives a persona: a goal, a hobby.

removeProfileDriver.what: Remove something that drives a persona.

setProfileCircleMembership.what: Remember on a persona that it is in a circle.

removeProfileCircleMembership.what: Take a circle off a persona, after leaving it.

setProfileDisclosure.what: Choose whether a persona shares something about itself in a circle.

getProfileDisclosure.what: Show what a persona shares where.

getPersonaView.what: Show "About me": what is recorded about a persona, and where it is shared.

getPersonaRelease.what: Show what a persona would share in a circle.

revokeAgent.what: Switch an agent off: all its rights end.

grantAgent.what: Give an agent a right, for a while.

params.expiresInDays: for how many days it holds
params.subject: who gets the right
params.persona: as which persona you give it

grantRole.what: Give someone a role in a circle.

params.subject: to whom
params.expiresInDays: for how many days it holds

revokeGrant.what: Take one right from an agent; the agent stays.

purgeAgent.what: Delete an agent for good, keeping nothing of it.

installAgent.what: Install an agent, with no rights until you give them.

params.grants: which rights it gets at once
params.name: the name
params.persona: as which persona you give them

listDataVersions.what: Show earlier versions of something in a circle's storage.

restoreDataVersion.what: Put something in a circle's storage back to an earlier version; that can be undone too.
